reviews.t: Polish for Dinner & then it starts to chip away
reviews.x: Ummm Ok I was happy when It really looked mirror like, but then I put gloss and it tuned into a regular shiny pink. So I tried it without gloss; it looks nice but it starts to chip off the moment you start to move your hands. The colors don't look much different from each other and I hate that I had to buy 3. It only last a few hours, if that's all you need.
Not the best quality! Way over price for a not so great product

I wish I would have read the reviews. These polishes do NOT have a mirror finish. For the price you pay for these you might as  well goo the  grocery store and buy shiny polish, it's the same thing and at least you know what you're getting. I would give zero stars if possible. I hope this review helps others avoid the mistake I made.
These don’t shine anything like it states. The silver has the best shine but they all pill right off once dry.

I have had these long enough to test all three colors. I'm satisfied these are clearly NOT frost. If you apply correctly, the mirror effect is better than the powders. However, the gold is more of a gold/green, not a true gold. The silver & rose gold are beautiful.  To apply correctly and have the mirror effect, you must adhere to nail tech guidelines!!  1. Wash & scrub your nails with a nail brush.  2. Dry your nails!  3. Apply a base coat. This is VERY important to have a filled in base on you

At first site it didn’t seem like the color. Once it set and dried it looked like the soft gold shiny color. With a clear coat of nail polish it made it pop more. I was seeking a metallic result. This is more of a soft gold look. I want the look of real gold on my nails. Not a bad buy. They also added in a small gift that was a nice touch (earrings). Cute.
If you want mirror shine, like as is advertised, DO NOT BUY. Also, this polish lasted a whopping 12 hours (with topcoat). It's cheap, it's matte, and it's not worth it.

They're alright. Same thing you can get at a discount beauty supply store.  These are NOT really mirror effect as advertised. Just shiny polish. The gold one is NOT NOT NOT the same gold represented on the outside of the bottle. It's a yellowish pale gold that's mediocre at best. The rose gold and silver are ok and freebies are cute for a young person which are the only reasons I gave 3 stars. More like 2.5.

The colors are very nice, but it’s extremely hard to apply. It doesn’t layer up well, but one coat is not enough, so it creates a weird texture. Also the smell is so strong I have to wonder what chemicals are in the product to make it smell so toxic and nauseating. It was a very good idea, ver poorly executed.

I like the way that this nail polish brushes over my nails. The polish is rich and covers the nails in two coats. The colors are pretty. You must put a clear bottom coat on your nails, and a clear top coat on your nails. This polish is fine, but in my opinion, it's not metallic. I wore this nail polish on my nails for 3 days before it started to chip. Is good for wearing on a special occasion, but will not look manicured for more than 3 days. reviews.t: If you want a smooth finish, save your money and look elsewhere!
reviews.x: These polishes don't go on smoothly but rather globby and streaked. Taking the polish off leaves a nasty color residue. I love the new mirror finishes but these polishes are a total waste of money and time!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the polish does not deliver the advertised mirror or chrome effect, describing it as regular, frost, or sparkly polish instead.
Several reviewers report poor durability, with the polish chipping or peeling off quickly after application.
Some reviewers feel the product is overpriced for its quality.
A few reviewers note the colors look similar to each other or differ from expectations, such as the gold appearing greenish or not a true gold.
One reviewer was satisfied, saying that when applied correctly the mirror effect is better than powders, though noting the gold is more gold/green.
